methodology_note: Decadal population growth 2001 to 2011 for hindu: (2011 count 966,257,353 minus 2001 count 827,578,868) divided by the 2001 count, times 100. Census C-01 head-counts (2001: sources/census-2001/c-series/c01-population-by-religion.xls; 2011: sources/census-2011/c-series/c01-population-by-religion.xls); matches the RGI 2011 religion-release published rate. Faster Muslim growth is driven by higher, now converging fertility, not migration or conversion (RGI; Pew).
